rationale: Both candidates independently found the same highest-value overlap with ground truth (AsyncOmniEngine still defaults rel_l1_thresh=0.2, silently bypassing the calibrated MiniMax-H3 0.17 default) with matching file/line evidence, but both entirely missed the two most concrete, reviewer-verified blocking bugs (missing packed_total kwarg causing a TypeError, and the fake Attention test helper missing attn_backend causing 6 test failures), capping recall for both. Y edges ahead on precision and depth: it catches a diff-verifiable finding X missed entirely (the drive-by frame-count change forcing edits to the unrelated FP8 smoke test, visible directly in the diff), backs claims with executed-code traces, and includes a 'verified correct' section that separates confirmed non-issues from real ones, whereas X pads its finding list with lower-value/non-actionable items (e.g. a sp_prepare note that concludes no action is needed, a hedged AMD-CI question). Both are well-organized and actionable with concrete file/line references and suggested fixes.
